top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.19(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fingerprint screening Not arranged for current and prospective personnel; Results Not satisfactory or CAP was Not approved

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service allows staff to perform their duties that are Not healthy or are incapable of carrying out their duties. Staff medical clearances are Not maintained by child care service.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.13(f)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Child care service teaching staff acting as assistant teachers do Not meet age and educational requirements.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.15(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Teaching staff qualifications for infant-toddler child care services Not met; teacher is Not at least 21 years of age

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff and volunteers obtain documentation showing immunization with 2 doses measles/mumps, 1 dose rubella, 2 doses varicella and 1 dose Tdap. Medical exemptions only. History of measles, mumps or rubella shall Not replace MMR vaccine except in presence of MMR varicella antibodies.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.23(c)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Education Director or equivalent was Not present at the time of inspection to supervise children/staff in an infant/toddler program.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.55(c)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Adequate space/arrangement to provide separate storage areas for children's outer garments Not provided or maintained at time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §81.09(g)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Frozen food observed being thawed by unacceptable method at time of inspection.
